test_STEP_PROFILER: test the StepProfiler context manager to measure code execution duration with Prometheus histogram metrics
test_LONG_STEP_PROFILER: test the LongStepProfiler context manager to measure code execution duration with custom Prometheus buckets
test_NESTED_STEP_PROFILER: test nested StepProfiler contexts to verify aggregated timing metrics across multiple steps
parse_metrics: parse a raw Prometheus metrics text string into a dictionary mapping metric names to float values
create_key: create a Prometheus histogram metric key string from a suffix, labels dict, and optional le bucket value
check_histogram_metric: check that a Prometheus histogram metric has the expected event count, bucket values, and duration sum
test_CACHE_METRICS: test the responses_in_cache_total Prometheus metric by inserting a cache metric document and calling update_responses_in_cache_total
test_QUEUE_METRICS: test the queue_jobs_total Prometheus metric by inserting a job metric document and calling update_queue_jobs_total
test_WORKER_SIZE_JOBS_COUNT: test the worker_size_jobs_count Prometheus metric by inserting a worker size document and calling update_worker_size_jobs_count
test_PROCESS_METRICS: test that the process_start_time_seconds metric is present and positive in single-process mode or absent in multiprocess mode
